parameters.command: set -euo pipefail; shopt -s nullglob; files=(/var/log/soar/incoming/*.json); if ((${#files[@]} == 0)); then echo "NO_FILES"; exit 0; fi; for f in "${files[@]}"; do while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do printf '%s\n' "$line" >> /var/log/soar/phishing-events.json; done < "$f"; rm -- "$f"; printf 'APPENDED: %s\n' "$f"; done; echo "DONE"
